components.name: Typed relation/witness stabilization compiler boundary
components.project_addition: Consumes established monoid-weighted/balanced partition mathematics inside the R004 typed future-language compiler. Makes MAY, witness-count and witness-label-set semantics explicit channels; proves the finite unique-coarsest stable-refinement specialization and semantic factor-map refinement rule; gives equal-cardinality incomparable COUNT/LABEL-SET safe partitions; and supplies 3-state cross-channel plus 5-state same-channel activation witnesses. The first Supplement-13 wording that generalized an operation raw-meet law to arbitrary operation languages was too broad and is explicitly corrected by Supplement 14; only one fixed operation family with varying observations has that meet law without extra hypotheses.

components.name: Mixed typed fixed-point dispatcher and generator descent
components.project_addition: Corrects the operation/relation dichotomy. Different total-operation families can cross-activate; a four-state counterexample is minimal under exhaustive unary search through three states, and an explicit n-state two-operation ping-pong family requires n-2 strict repairs, making the finite block-count bound sharp. Defines one mixed signature for already-compiled total unary contexts, partial legality/output tags and monoid relation block aggregates; proves the terminal fixed point is the unique coarsest jointly safe refinement; and gives the modular fair-worklist form. Partial legality is reduced to tagged totalization at the compatibility layer. For semiring-valued stable relation matrices, the quotient block-sum map is used as a semiring homomorphism certificate, so finite relation syntax generated by + and composition descends from a finite generator basis. Boolean specialization gives exact finite path lifting/reachability. Generic fixed-point, congruence, weighted/coalgebraic refinement and semiring machinery remain prior art; R004 owns only the finite Enterprise Math typed interface/correction/counterexample package.
